title: SlashZero Demo
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#939, 2026-11-03), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.24, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, D3DMetal, rated 1 of 5 after 1 minutes: the logo shows, then the game's own crash window ('The UE-Zero Game has crashed', Fatal error!) before the title screen. Not verified by the maintainer. udance4ever again in a comment on highball-db#939 (2026-11-03) with the game's own log: about a minute after start it stops on 'Unhandled Exception: 0xc06d007f', raised from kernelbase, the code for a delay-loaded function that wasn't found. udance4ever again in a comment on highball-db#939 (2026-11-04), in a Wine 11 environment on engine x64-crossover26.3-r28 with D3DMetal: no crash, but Steam shows a black window with white boxes, which the reporter takes for a licence agreement, and Highball keeps waiting for the game. Steam's helpers crash in that log ('-[NSViewBackingLayer setDisplaySyncEnabled:]: unrecognized selector'), Steam's window not drawing under D3DMetal. udance4ever again in a comment on highball-db#939 (2026-11-06): in the Wine 10 environment, with Steam started through Open Steam and the demo started from Steam's Play button, Unreal's message 'DirectX 12 is not supported on your system' came up. Steam started that way runs outside D3DMetal and the game inherits it, so it has no Direct3D 12 there, most likely the route rather than the game.
notes: Doesn't start in one report on an M1 with D3DMetal. An Unreal Engine game on DirectX 12, it shows its logo and then a Fatal error crash window.

knownIssues.symptom: Unreal Engine 'Fatal error!' crash window right after the logo (M1, D3DMetal, Wine 10 r29)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. The game's log ends with 'Unhandled Exception: 0xc06d007f', which is the code a program raises when a function it loads late from a DLL isn't there, so the game most likely asks one of Wine's DLLs for a function Wine doesn't have. Which one isn't known yet

knownIssues.symptom: On a Wine 11 engine with D3DMetal, Steam shows a black window with white boxes at the first launch and the game never starts (M1, Wine 11 r28)
knownIssues.cause: most likely the licence agreement Steam shows before a game's first launch, in a window Steam can't draw while the environment is on D3DMetal (as with Phantom Blade Zero, highball#570)
knownIssues.fix: untested with this game. Quit Steam from the strip at the bottom of Highball, press Open Steam (Steam then opens in a mode that draws), press Play on the demo in Steam and accept the agreement, quit Steam from the strip again, then press Play in Highball
